videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of the provided YouTube video transcript in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences capturing the key points.
Key information from the transcript:
1. It's the first day of early voting for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections (May 29th)
2. Early voting runs for two days (today and tomorrow) from 6 AM to 6 PM
3. Anyone with a photo ID (resident registration card, passport, driver's license, or mobile ID) can vote at any of the 3,571 polling stations nationwide, regardless of their registered address

5. Voters receive 7 ballots (or 4 in Sejong/Jeju), plus 1 more if there's a National Assembly by-election in their area
